titleEn: I'm Beside You in the Dark!

pages.text: "Dad, don't turn it off!" Dad was about to blow out the bedroom lamp. Dari pulled his quilt to his nose. "Dark is scary! Leave it on!" Kongal already slept softly in the cradle.
"Try sleeping without it? I'll be just upstairs." Dad blew it out. Darkness filled the room. Dari's heart thumped.
The lighthouse beam swept through the round window. A huge pointed shadow slid across the wall! Dari gripped a shell in his mouth and trembled. "What's that?"
At a small sob, Dad came down. "You got scared. It's okay. I'm beside you in the dark." He lit the little lamp, sat beside Dari, and held his flipper.
"What frightened you?" Dad asked gently. Dari pointed. "That spiky monster." Dad nodded. "Let's look at each thing."
Dad lifted the lamp toward the wall. "My raincoat and hat!" The monster was just the hanging raincoat. Dari raised his head. "Not a monster?"

Now Dari held the lamp. Light on the round shadow—"The shell basket!" Light on the rocking shadow—"Kongal's cradle!" Nothing was scary up close. Dari snuggled beside Dad. "I'm beside you in the dark!"
Dari wasn't afraid anymore. "Dark just means the lamp's off!" He tapped his tail beneath the quilt. Kongal smiled in a dream.
Dad taught the steps. "One, say 'I'm scared.' Two, look at things one by one with the lamp. Three, hold someone's flipper tight." Dari held Dad's and nodded.
Dad hugged Dari and left the little lamp glowing very softly. "It's okay to feel afraid. I'm here." Dari drifted off beside Kongal's cradle. I'm beside you in the dark!
